verdict.rationale: Docs claim each finding includes the 'full source-to-sink call chain,' implying cross-file/cross-function taint tracing, but hands-on community reports show concrete failures: missed a real vulnerability that another tool (Semgrep AI) caught in a C project, flagged two non-existent vulnerabilities at 100% confidence, and returned an implausible/inaccurate finding on another repo. Missing for 10: independent validation of accurate cross-boundary taint detection, reproducible examples of correct multi-file vulnerability chains, and resolution of the false-positive/false-negative reports.
